items.html: And when the world of Atzilut was created, and ZON were born, she began to grow until the fourth day of the days of Genesis; and then she grew all the three aspects mentioned above that there are in the aspect of the back in the back, namely until she became the aspect of a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, in the back, opposite the back of the chest. And there the measure of her stature was from there and below; and also the lights of the first five Sefirot of ZA were illuminating in her, from above downward, back to back.
